description: [FREE: 25 calls/day, then $0.005 USDC per call via x402] Runs an UNSIGNED entry-function transaction through the node's own simulator (no key needed, nothing is submitted) and returns success or the abort decoded in plain English, exact gas and fee, balance changes, and events. Arguments are type-checked against the module ABI first. Balance changes count only the framework's Withdraw/Deposit events, so assets that re-emit them (like USDC) are never double-counted. A simulation runs against the node's current state and cannot be pinned to an older ledger version.

chain.description: Aptos CAIP-2 id: aptos:1 (mainnet, default) or aptos:2 (testnet)
